problem_text:
A regional aircraft maintenance inspector must conduct a scheduled safety check at 11 different airfields:
Airfield Alpha: Positioned at grid reference (128,81)
Airfield Bravo: Positioned at grid reference (126,166)
Airfield Charlie: Positioned at grid reference (15,113)
Airfield Delta: Positioned at grid reference (76,36)
Airfield Echo: Positioned at grid reference (190,126)
Airfield Foxtrot: Positioned at grid reference (13,159)
Airfield Golf: Positioned at grid reference (55,6)
Airfield Hotel: Positioned at grid reference (90,120)
Airfield India: Positioned at grid reference (100,2)
Airfield Juliet: Positioned at grid reference (134,17)
Airfield Kilo: Positioned at grid reference (175,20)

The flight distances between these airfields, measured in nautical miles, are precisely known:
Alpha to Charlie: 117.4 nm
Alpha to Delta: 68.8 nm
Alpha to Echo: 76.6 nm
Alpha to Foxtrot: 139.0 nm
Alpha to Golf: 104.7 nm
Alpha to Hotel: 54.5 nm
Alpha to India: 83.8 nm
Alpha to Juliet: 64.3 nm
Alpha to Kilo: 77.0 nm
Bravo to Charlie: 123.0 nm
Bravo to Delta: 139.3 nm
Bravo to Echo: 75.5 nm
Bravo to Foxtrot: 113.2 nm
Bravo to Golf: 175.0 nm
Bravo to Hotel: 58.4 nm
Bravo to India: 166.0 nm
Bravo to Juliet: 149.2 nm
Bravo to Kilo: 154.0 nm
Charlie to Delta: 98.2 nm
Charlie to Echo: 175.5 nm
Charlie to Foxtrot: 46.0 nm
Charlie to Golf: 114.2 nm
Charlie to Hotel: 75.3 nm
Charlie to India: 139.8 nm
Charlie to Juliet: 152.9 nm
Charlie to Kilo: 185.1 nm
Delta to Echo: 145.2 nm
Delta to Foxtrot: 138.2 nm
Delta to Golf: 36.6 nm
Delta to Hotel: 85.2 nm
Delta to India: 41.6 nm
Delta to Juliet: 61.0 nm
Delta to Kilo: 100.3 nm
Echo to Foxtrot: 180.0 nm
Echo to Golf: 180.6 nm
Echo to Hotel: 100.2 nm
Echo to India: 153.2 nm
Echo to Juliet: 122.5 nm
Echo to Kilo: 107.1 nm
Foxtrot to Golf: 158.7 nm
Foxtrot to Hotel: 86.3 nm
Foxtrot to India: 179.5 nm
Foxtrot to Juliet: 186.6 nm
Foxtrot to Kilo: 213.5 nm
Golf to Hotel: 119.3 nm
Golf to India: 45.2 nm
Golf to Juliet: 79.8 nm
Golf to Kilo: 120.8 nm
Hotel to India: 118.4 nm
Hotel to Juliet: 112.0 nm
Hotel to Kilo: 131.2 nm
India to Juliet: 37.2 nm
India to Kilo: 77.1 nm
Juliet to Kilo: 41.1 nm

Due to airspace restrictions, a direct flight corridor between Airfield Alpha and Airfield Bravo is permanently closed.
Furthermore, due to simultaneous maintenance on certain routes, the inspection circuit must incorporate exactly one of the following two mandatory flight legs: the corridor between Airfield Bravo and Airfield Charlie, or the corridor between Airfield Charlie and Airfield Delta.

The objective is to determine the most fuel-efficient inspection circuit that visits each airfield exactly once and returns to the point of origin.
